name: Otto Heinrich Warburg
summary: Nobel Laureate researcher known for work on photosynthesis and cell respiration mechanisms.

name: Emil Warburg
summary: Physicist and father of Otto Warburg who introduced the concept of photolyte.

name: Erwin Negelein
summary: Long-standing collaborator of Otto Warburg in photosynthesis research.

name: Frederick F. Blackman
summary: Plant physiologist whose findings on CO2 and light curves Warburg interpreted.

name: Gabrielle L. C. Matthaei
summary: Collaborator of Frederick Blackman in vegetable assimilation research.

name: Richard Willstätter
summary: Researcher who discovered the occurrence of chlorophyll and proposed photosynthesis models.

name: Horace Brown
summary: English plant physiologist whose work on intermittent illumination inspired Warburg.

name: Physikalisch-Technische Reichsanstalt
summary: Berlin optical laboratory led by Emil Warburg where Otto Warburg conducted experiments.

name: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
summary: Prestigious award given to Warburg for discovery of the nature and mode of action of the respiratory enzyme.

name: On the rate of photochemical carbonic acid decomposition
aliases: Über die Geschwindigkeit der photochemischen Kohlensäurezersetzung
summary: Warburg's first paper on photosynthesis introducing manometric methods.

name: On the rate of photochemical carbonic acid decomposition II
aliases: Über die Geschwindigkeit der photochemischen Kohlensäurezersetzung II
summary: Warburg's second article on photosynthesis mechanism.

name: Theorie der Kohlensäureassimilation
summary: Synopsis of Warburg's findings in Die Naturwissenschaften.

name: Über den Energieumsatz bei der Kohlensäureassimilation
summary: First account of the quantum yield of photosynthesis.

name: Über den Einfluss der Wellenlänge auf den Energieumsatz bei der Kohlensäureassimilation
summary: Paper on the influence of wavelength on photosynthetic efficiency.

name: Chlorella
summary: Model organism substituted by Warburg for leaves and whole plants.

name: Manometer
summary: Apparatus used by Warburg for measuring the rate of photosynthesis.
